about: How monsters show what they feel. A monster near the player says a short line (the lines are in apps/citywalk/src/th.ts, chatter) now and then, and when something happens to it: chance per event (1 = always, even right after speaking). gap: seconds it stays quiet after a line. idleEvery: seconds between idle remarks [shortest, longest]. hearRange: metres from the player within which monsters talk. showFor: seconds a line stays up. maxBubbles: lines on screen at once. emote: the mark that pops over its head for each event (excl, anger, sweat, swirl, note, zzz). blinkEvery / blinkFor: seconds between blinks and how long the eyes stay shut. squash: how much a sprite squashes and stretches (share of its height): breathe while still, land after a hop, stretch in the air, and how fast it springs back.
